issues.description: Wrong page is being displayed. The current URL http://localhost:3000/dashboard is showing the authenticated dashboard instead of the marketing landing page. The root route '/' should show the landing page with hero image, gold CTA button, and marketing content.
issues.element: Entire page - showing dashboard instead of landing page
issues.root_cause: The root route '/' likely redirects to '/dashboard' without checking authentication, or the landing page at apps/web/app/page.tsx redirects authenticated/unauthenticated users directly to /dashboard instead of showing the marketing page.

issues.description: Multiple React hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' appearing 7 times, causing entire root to switch to client rendering. Likely caused by dynamic date/time content (e.g., 'Good evening, Amelia.' greeting or 'Thursday, April 16' date) being rendered differently on server vs client.
issues.element: Dashboard page - greeting text and/or date display
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/dashboard/page.tsx, dynamic content like time-based greeting ('Good evening') or date ('Thursday, April 16') is computed during SSR with a different value than during client hydration. Using new Date() or similar without suppressing hydration or using useEffect causes this mismatch.

issues.description: Failed to fetch RSC payload for /design/step-7d - page likely missing or has a server error, causing browser fallback navigation.
issues.root_cause: apps/web/app/design/step-7d/page.tsx either doesn't exist or has a runtime error preventing the RSC payload from being served.

fixes.old_str:
const hour = new Date().getHours();
  const greeting = hour < 12 ? 'Good morning' : hour < 18 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening';
fixes.reason: Fix hydration mismatch by computing time-based greeting only on client side via useEffect, initializing with a default value that matches SSR output.

fixes.old_str: const dateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });
fixes.reason: Fix hydration mismatch for date string by computing it only on the client side via useEffect to ensure server and client render the same initial value.
